title.narrative: Smart and Climate Friendly Logistics in India

description.narrative: Decarbonisation of India’s freight transport and logistics sector will majorly contribute to India meeting its NDC commitments. Modal shift to cleaner transport modes for long haul freight, energy shift, use of innovative green solutions and technology are promising decarbonisation measures if adopted system wide. The project has 3 major outputs – develop a knowledge exchange platform; build capacities of training institutions for enhancing green skills of India’s logistics workforce; develop green strategies and solutions for freight transport and logistics decarbonization. With the institutionalisation of knowledge exchange platforms, promoting innovative smart and green solutions and capacity development of policy makers and implementing agencies will strengthen India’s capabilities to achieve its ambitious net-zero emission targets.
